description: This file is a shell script (`.sh`) used for testing the Git ref-store API. It contains test cases for creating, deleting, renaming, and verifying refs and reflogs in a Git repository, executing various commands and checking their outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and checks for successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail, used for verifying error conditions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified message or changes; used throughout tests for setup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual outputs, files, or values to verify correctness.
